accessibility.aria_guidelines: Ensure all interactive elements have appropriate aria-labels. Use data-testid on all key elements for testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Update index.css to import these.
Do NOT use bright colors for backgrounds or panels. Keep it strictly minimal: #FAFAF8 for background, #FFFFFF for cards.
Use Gold (#C9A227) EXCLUSIVELY for accents: primary buttons, active sidebar indicators, or key notification badges. NO gradients.
Do not use card components everywhere; where appropriate, use border layouts to separate sections for an enterprise feel.
Data tables should be extremely clean with light grey text for headers, and bold dark text for data, using status badges where applicable.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide icons, styled minimally (e.g., stroke-width 1.5, text-[#6B7280]).
Build the dashboard layout with a sticky top bar containing breadcrumbs, user role switcher, and AI assistant badge.
Render the timeline and approval queues with strict alignment and minimal vertical connecting lines.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Implement glass-morphism effects ONLY where appropriate (e.g., sticky top nav with backdrop-blur-md and bg-white/90). Never fully transparent.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use left alignment for data and forms. Maintain crisp edges and generous spacing.
Create depth through subtle layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft box shadows.
NEVER use generic AI emoji icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, but keep it strictly professional and subtle.
